improvement: English ‘next month’ and French ‘le mois prochain’ reported-end-date follow-ups now retain the selected FONGIM, World Bank or EU project identifiers before fresh source retrieval.
reproduced_before: Both next-calendar-month forms returned no structured resolution and lost the selected project set.

qualification.fresh_retrieval_guard: Only selected source identifiers, a previously established active-only constraint and the newly requested calendar month carry forward. Prior dates, statuses, reach claims and answer facts are excluded.
qualification.period_guard: The next UTC calendar month is frozen to exact inclusive first-day and last-day bounds, including December-to-January rollover and leap February, before fresh retrieval.
qualification.ambiguity_guard: Named competing periods, unnamed mixed-source rosters, compound periods and analytical additions continue through semantic resolution.
qualification.api_guard: The bounded next-calendar-month path skips semantic rewriting and invokes exactly one fresh research lookup in the API test.

deployment.blocker: Exact-SHA deployment to the authorised V4 test service requires a secure signed-in dashboard session. Generic deployment remains unsafe because the configured source branch is older and divergent.
deployment.next_action: Deploy published_code_commit to V4 test only, then live-test bilingual next-month, current-month, current-year, next-year, explicit-range, mixed-roster, active-only, catalogue, empty-subset, FONGIM selected-ID and geography regressions.

rollback.database: No schema or data change. Retain the existing additive evaluation schema and reviewed source facts.

continuity.do_not_repeat: Do not rebuild the active-only, empty-subset, French catalogue, mixed-source, explicit-range, next-calendar-year, French current-calendar-year, French-pronoun, current-month or next-month fixes. Reconcile the latest candidate branch and service before exact-SHA deployment.
continuity.if_deployment_still_blocked: Continue the next bounded Q-006 topic-change or supported-time-filter continuity case after reproducing it.

preservation: Accepted PADEL publication, FONGIM selection, geography, source catalogue, response, dossier and account behavior retained; no database, source record, service configuration, access, production or administration change.
limitations: Only unambiguous ‘next month’ and ‘le mois prochain’ reported-end-date wording uses the new deterministic next-calendar-month path.
Long or truncated rosters, more than twelve identifiers, unnamed mixed-source sets, compound periods and analytical cross-source questions continue through semantic resolution.
No live acceptance, actual-database qualification or full model benchmark was performed.
spending: All qualification was local and made no external model or research calls.
